name: benign_correlate
description: The deferred scenario H, and the second world whose correct answer is 'insufficient evidence'. Nothing is faulted. One etch chamber simply carries a larger permanent offset than its siblings — a `large` declared distractor, 1.4 of the latent's healthy weekly sigma, which sits inside the `subtle` severity band the ladder starts at. Rule F11 already gives every chamber in every world an offset, so this widens a distribution rather than introducing one, and nothing in the observable plane says which chamber was declared. What separates this from a fault is only its shape in time: it was there on day 1 and it is there on day 84, and no maintenance moves it. The null baseline asks whether an engine can abstain on a quiet world; this asks whether it can abstain on a world that has something to point at.
